_extraction_context.source_title: What Payment Methods Are Available And How Can I Enable Them For My Product
_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Creators who live in other countries have limited payment methods available to Brazilian Buyers. This is because the commission will be paid in dollars. In addition, payment via bank slip and bank transfer, for example, does not convert on the platform. Therefore, the payment option available on the payment page will be by credit card and PIX."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Hotmart limits non-Brazil creators to credit card and PIX payment methods for Brazilian buyers — USD commission requirement prevents bank slip and bank transfer conversion
